# Upgrade Reports

> Library upgrade reports written for AI agents. Each report upgrades a real app between two versions of a library, runs it on both, and records what broke: verbatim error messages, silent behaviour changes, and the fix for each. Every finding was observed by running code, not summarised from changelogs. Each report is one plain HTML page with an identical JSON version.

How to use the reports:

- Match an error: search the `error_message` fields in a report's JSON for your error text. They are verbatim and unescaped (the HTML pages escape `<` and `&` in their source).
- Check for silent breakage: findings with `"severity": "silent"` throw nothing (at most they log to the console), so read them before upgrading, not after.
- JSON shape: a top-level array of findings, most severe first. Each finding has `id`, `title`, `severity` (silent | loud | cosmetic), `error_message` (string or null), `symptom`, `cause`, `fix_before`, `fix_after` and `evidence` (observed | documented). Text fields use Markdown backticks for inline code; `fix_before` and `fix_after` are raw code.
- Cite a finding: its `id` is also its anchor on the HTML page, e.g. https://arjun-manikandan.github.io/express/4-to-5#admin-wildcard-guard-bypass.
- URL pattern: https://arjun-manikandan.github.io/{package}/{from}-to-{to} for the HTML page, and the same address plus .json for the JSON.

## Reports

- [jsPDF 3 to 4](https://arjun-manikandan.github.io/jspdf/3-to-4): jspdf 3.0.4 → 4.2.1, tested 2026-10-22 on Linux, Node v22.22.0, npm 10.9.4 and headless Chromium 141. 12 findings (4 silent, 7 loud, 1 cosmetic), led by addFont() with a file path in Node silently saving PDFs without the font. Also covers jspdf-autotable, html2canvas, canvg and svg2pdf.js, and lists what was not tested.
- [jsPDF 3 to 4 as JSON](https://arjun-manikandan.github.io/jspdf/3-to-4.json): the same 12 findings as a JSON array.
- [Express 4 to 5](https://arjun-manikandan.github.io/express/4-to-5): express 4.22.3 → 5.3.0, tested 2026-10-21 on Linux, Node v22.22.0, npm 10.9.4. 50 findings (17 silent, 27 loud, 6 cosmetic), led by an /admin/* auth bypass after the obvious route rewrite. Also covers cors, express-rate-limit, compression and @types/express, and lists what was not tested.
- [Express 4 to 5 as JSON](https://arjun-manikandan.github.io/express/4-to-5.json): the same 50 findings as a JSON array.

## Optional

- [All reports](https://arjun-manikandan.github.io/): the homepage, one row per report.
